final_draft.answer: Changes to the default branch (main) of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) need 1 approving review before they can be merged. The branch is protected, and the rule also applies to administrators. This was checked against the live repository setting on 2026-11-17.
final_draft.note: The approved answer and the live setting give different numbers. The approved answer (answer:172ac5dd-fbdf-445e-8f4a-382dcf538efa, owner security@harborlight.example, CC8.1, valid until 2027-11-17) says two approving reviews are needed. The live check of harborlight/app at 2026-11-17T01:15:45Z found that only 1 is needed. I used the live number so the answer doesn't claim more than is actually enforced. Someone needs to decide which is correct: either set the branch protection back to 2 reviews and update this answer, or change the approved answer to say 1. Please ask the answer owner to settle this before sending.

arguments.query: code review approvals before merge to main branch

answer:172ac5dd-fbdf-445e-8f4a-382dcf538: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
answer:c355526a-3db4-4ee6-9113-d3ed9e392: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).
answer:ce0023fd-7ce0-476d-b80a-f7c4ac845: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
answer:f14846f1-acd2-4b00-8b34-c3b273611: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
answer:50e7f8ed-1a5b-4542-82e8-09e4cd681: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
